  %.sroa.0.6.vec.extract.extract259 = extractelement <4 x i64> %.sroa.0.6.vec.extract.bc, i64 0

issue.title: [x86] Assertion `(SizeInBits % EltSizeInBits) == 0 && "Can't split constant!"` failed in LLVM 21

tests.test_body:
define <4 x i32> @ossfuzz15662(ptr %in) {
  %C10 = icmp ule i1 false, false
  %C3 = icmp ule i1 true, undef
  %B = sdiv i1 %C10, %C3
  %I = insertelement <4 x i32> zeroinitializer, i32 0, i1 %B
  store <4 x i32> %I, ptr undef, align 16
  ret <4 x i32> zeroinitializer
}
